articles.title: Two Chinese cloud providers have the same broken IP metadata. One is 6x more likely to be blacklisted.
articles.excerpt: Tencent Cloud and Alibaba Cloud look identical on paper. Both assign IPs with essentially no reverse DNS — Tencent at 29/30 missing, Alibaba at 30/30. Neither publishes a registrant organisation in RD…
articles.body: Tencent Cloud and Alibaba Cloud look identical on paper. Both assign IPs with essentially no reverse DNS — Tencent at 29/30 missing, Alibaba at 30/30. Neither publishes a registrant organisation in RDAP — every single Tencent IP in this sample (30/30) returns no registrant on record, the only provider of the twelve at 100%. Their blocklist rates are not identical. Provider PTR missing No registrant On a blocklist Tencent Cloud 29/30 30/30 6/30 (20%) Alibaba Cloud 30/30 18/30 1/30 (3.3%) Six times the listing rate, from two providers whose IP metadata is equally broken. Metadata cannot tell them apart Everything you can look up without querying a blocklist — PTR record, RDAP registrant, abuse contact — comes back equally empty for both.

articles.body: “예약 사이트 하나 만드는 데 얼마예요?”라는 문의에는 아직 계산할 작업이 없습니다. 신청을 남기는 화면인지, 빈 시간을 보여 주는 화면인지, 결제와 취소까지 필요한 화면인지가 빠져 있기 때문입니다. 혼자 개발과 상담을 맡는다면 첫 문의를 바로 개발 티켓으로 옮기기보다, 무엇을 더 확인해야 하는지 보이는 접수 기록 으로 남겨 보세요. 정보가 부족하다는 것과 진행할 수 없다는 것은 다른 상태입니다. 기능 목록은 문의에 없는 것을 추측해서 채우기보다, 확인된 결과에서 시작합니다. 요청 문장을 기능 목록으로 바로 바꾸지 마세요 아래는 가상의 홈페이지 제작 문의입니다. 전화로 예약을 받고 있는데, 고객이 사이트에서 신청하게 하고 싶어요. 다음 달에는 열면 좋겠습니다. 이 한 줄에서 확인된 것은 예약 접수의 불편과 희망 시점입니다. 온라인 결제, 로그인, 문자 발송, 관리자 화면의 구체적인 형태는 아직 정해지지 않았습니다. 내가 익숙한 기능을 전부 추가하면 고객이 요청하지 않은 범위까지 견적에 들어갑니다. 먼저 “신청을 받으면 담당자가 확인할까요, 빈 시간을 선택하면 바로 확정될까요?”처럼 결과를 바꾸는 질문부터 하세요. 필요한 기능은 그 답에서 나옵니다. 접수 기록에는 다섯 묶음만 둡니다 확인할 묶음 남길 내용 빈칸이면 할 질문 목적 현재 어떤 일이 불편한지 지금은 어떻게 처리하고 있나요? 결과물 고객이 하려는 행동과 준비된 자료 신청만 받으면 될까요, 확정까지 필요할까요? 일정 희망 날짜와 반드시 지켜야 하는 날짜 그 날짜를 넘기면 어떤 일이 달라지나요?

articles.title: I Ran the Zombie Match Cut on 4 Video Models: Frame Timing and Cut Placement
articles.excerpt: You've probably seen the TikTok trend captioned "would you still love me if I were a zombie." It relies on a classic editing trick: the match cut. The scene starts as an armed standoff inside a snowed…
articles.body: You've probably seen the TikTok trend captioned "would you still love me if I were a zombie." It relies on a classic editing trick: the match cut. The scene starts as an armed standoff inside a snowed-in cabin. Then it jumps into a warm embrace from an earlier memory. To pull that off in one step, an AI model needs to align the movement across two different scenes. You need character likeness, clean timing, and a cut that lands without extra editing. The 5-Beat Spec and Pass Criteria We treat this sequence as a five-beat specification. When we look at a generated clip, we judge it against five clear checks: The aim: You see tears, a raised pistol, and someone who clearly can't shoot. The drop: The defender drops the gun and opens their arms.

articles.body: Dated data post · 2026-10-07 · all numbers first-hand, snapshot time-stamped Ask.com closed on May 1, 2026 . The farewell page is blunt: "As IAC continues to sharpen its focus, we have made the decision to discontinue our search business, which includes Ask.com." — © 2026 IAC Inc. I verified the farewell page live, and the question pages behind it: random /question/ paths now 404 on a GitHub Pages shell. Twenty years of self-service Q&A, dark in a week, with no content license released anywhere I could find. So I went to the one place that definitely had copies: the Internet Archive. This post is the result — a dated preservation snapshot of the corpus, the method, the licensing status, and the honest limits.

articles.title: Understanding When to Use Factory Method vs. Abstract Factory Design Patterns: Key Differences and Use Cases
articles.excerpt: Introduction to Design Patterns: Factory Method vs. Abstract Factory When diving into the world of design patterns, the Factory Method and Abstract Factory often stand out as go-to solutions for objec…
articles.body: Introduction to Design Patterns: Factory Method vs. Abstract Factory When diving into the world of design patterns, the Factory Method and Abstract Factory often stand out as go-to solutions for object creation. However, their differences are subtle yet profound, and misunderstanding them can lead to code that’s harder to maintain, scale, or extend. Let’s break down their core mechanisms and why one isn’t always a substitute for the other. Core Mechanisms: What Breaks When You Misapply Them At their heart, both patterns abstract object creation, but they differ in scope and responsibility . The Factory Method focuses on delegating the instantiation of a single product type to subclasses .
